rationale: Provides a policy-as-code framework using OPA Rego to formalize governance rules into enforceable constraints on AI agent actions.
Intercepts and automatically verifies AI agent events and tool calls against formal policy specifications in real time.
Computes data Shapley values across ML pipelines to measure and quantify the influence of individual training data points on model behavior.
Provides a declarative policy engine to formalize security rules and execution boundaries for AI coding agents.
Intercepts and automatically verifies AI agent tool calls in real time against formal policy specifications.
Provides a static deterministic merge gate to automatically verify that AI agent capability changes comply with policy specifications.
Implements SHA-256 hash-chained and cryptographically verifiable audit logging for AI agent events to make decision records tamper-evident.
Enforces deterministic governance policies and scoped execution controls across multi-agent and federated enterprise AI deployments using cryptographic identity (Ed25519) and execution tokens.
Implements automated PII stripping and redaction on downstream LLM query logs and prompts before storage in audit databases to ensure privacy-safe auditability.
Uses Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) and verifiable cryptographic credentials to establish provenance and enforce scoped governance policies across multi-party AI agent deployments.
